🆕 New (Posted: August 18, 2026)

Notice

The Nagarebashi Bridge connecting Asu Athletic Park and Iwasawa Athletic Park has been damaged by heavy rain. The bridge deck has been swept away and the bridge is currently closed to traffic. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

Repair Timeline

Once the river water level drops and conditions allow us to reinstall the bridge deck, we will update our website with repair progress information.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/tosikensetubu/ijikanrika/14269.html
